allowed_wording: We test whether resolution-dependent evolutionary predictability aligns across independent flower-colour radiations at macroevolutionary state-representation, phenotype-axis-to-molecular-subspace, and mechanistic-recurrence levels.
evidence_gap: Only the Petunieae hue component is prospectively specified under the matched phenotype-axis bridge; broader external replication remains partly retrospective and observation regimes remain heterogeneous.
next_gate: Expand independent hue/branching and pigment-amount/depletion systems under explicit tiered admission rules, keeping prospective and retrospective evidence separate, then rerun the novelty and journal gate.
